title: Hold conditions — when action must stop for human sovereign
doctrine: Static law. Agents may propose; they may not clear a HOLD.

conditions.clearance: explicit F13 ACK token + human presence

conditions.when: Change to F1–F13 definitions, veto logic, or epistemic tag system
Change to DID, canonical domain, or sovereign owner fields
Public/private or proprietary disclosure boundary change
examples: promote proprietary well coords to public without gate

conditions.when: Machine endpoint meaning changes without version bump
conditions.clearance: version bump minimum; 888_HOLD if binding contract meaning flips

conditions.when: Money movement, new paid API > $10/mo, secret rotation/exposure
Hard floor would be violated (F1,F2,F7,F9,F10,F11,F12,F13 as HARD)
conditions.clearance: cannot be cleared by agent autonomy

conditions.when: Soft floor tension (F5, F6) or low FQ / WELL degradation for high-stakes work
